subtitle: 초행 탱커 기 살려주는 츤데레 고인물

cuts.speaker: 트롤 주술사
cuts.dialogue:
아 탱커하는 뉴비들
진짜 한 대 쳐버리고 싶네!

On the right, timid newbie Orc Warrior prot tank holding a compact one-handed sword and sturdy steel kite shield shrinks back trembling with tiny sweat drops.

Newbie Orc Warrior prot tank snaps from nervous to blazingly confident with huge sparkling starry crimson eyes, a heroic determined grin, rosy cheeks, and radiant golden hype burst lines behind her as she grips her sturdy steel shield rim near her chest (zero text or letters).
